name: Molecular and Cellular Biology (MCB) PhD Program
detailsNote: Official information available. December 1 is published without a year (the program page speaks of the class of 2026), so it is not confirmed for Fall 2027. The application fee is $150 on the newer admissions page; the program page says $100 and an older page says $75.
summary: Guarini School PhD program in molecular and cellular biology at Dartmouth. Students complete three research rotations, selected at the beginning of each term.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Official page gives this date without a year; not confirmed for Fall 2027. Confirm the Fall 2027 date with the program.

timeline.interviews: Interviews are held virtually in January.

english.note: Required for non-US citizens unless the degree is from a US or Canadian institution or the language of instruction was English. The scores are recommended ranges from the Graduate Studies page, which is dated 2025. Self-reported scores are accepted when applying; official results are required after admission.

applicationFee.note: Program page links to fee waiver criteria on a page that could not be opened, so waiver terms are not stated here.

documents: Unofficial transcripts (official ones required for enrollment)
requirements.note: The program says GRE scores are not required, though a strong score may help.

international.note: Language proficiency scores are required for non-US citizens; no limit on international applicants is stated.
